name: page-link
summary: Navigate with a real anchor and expose active state.

npm.registration: The npm root registers its custom elements automatically.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

active.description: Fires when the link active state changes.

guidance: Use descriptive text for the anchor. The anchor is exposed as CSS part anchor.
Use $ for nearest route path and ~ for current path; omit path to change query on the current view.
The active marker is reflected by the component; do not set it to navigate.
Use page-link with history routing. In this release, use a native anchor with href="#/path" in hash mode to avoid a second hash prefix.
